reponse: Since PR #447, the old method no longer works: FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored [2]. To enable dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page [2][3]. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. Note the flag was renamed from new_dash to dashboards_v2 [2], and if tiles appear blank in a new workspace, that's a known issue with an empty state being worked on [5].
